DESCRIPTION: A duplicate event here means the customer is notified - or charged - twice.
NAME: test_replayed_request_does_not_emit_a_second_event

DESCRIPTION: A retried request with the same idempotency key must return the original payment and must not charge the customer twice. This is the single most expensive defect class in a payments API.
NAME: test_replayed_idempotency_key_returns_original_payment
Amount 0: zero is not a payment

DESCRIPTION: Validates the published payload against an independently-declared schema with extra='forbid'. Both a missing field and an unannounced new field fail this test - schema drift in a payments topic is an incident, not a detail.
NAME: test_event_matches_published_contract

DESCRIPTION: The only test in the suite that spans all three layers: a click in the browser must end up as an event on the Kafka topic. Everything narrower than this is already covered more cheaply elsewhere.
NAME: test_ui_submission_reaches_the_event_stream[chromium]
